name: Sri Harmandir Sahib (Golden Temple)
path: Sri Harmandir Sahib (Golden Temple), Amritsar, India
summary: Preeminent spiritual sanctuary of Sikhism, bathed in real gold and surrounded by the holy Amrit Sarovar.
points: Founded in 1577 CE by fourth Sikh Guru, Guru Ram Das; sanctum gilded with pure gold leaf in 1830 by Maharaja Ranjit Singh
Designed with four open entrances welcoming all castes and faiths; serves over 100,000 free meals daily in world's largest community kitchen (Langar)
